text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Average daily minimum air
temperature—minus two degrees. Average

monthly sunshine hours—forty.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
As indicated by the data, December in
Germany is dark and cold.
Simultaneously,
it is a period when lights of 2,700 degrees
Kelvin
illuminate the night.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The holiday season is one of the most
important times of year for
many Germans,
and is one of the busiest for my parents'
cake shop.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
My father would skip sleep to prepare. I
remember those bloodshot
eyes measuring
every cup of sugar to the gram, the love
and labor
that went into the mix.

text_block_list.name: Flash's Father
text_block_list.text: ...A gram over. This requires a slight reduction.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
To my young mind, his excessive devotion
must have seemed
concerning. I asked him
a question which I now realize had been

utterly misguided.

text_block_list.name: Young Flash
text_block_list.text: Papa, why do you have to be so exact? A small mistake won't make your cakes any less yummy.

text_block_list.name: Flash's Father
text_block_list.text: Flash, listen carefully. An error of even just one gram...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...can throw everything off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day out on the track, as I'm watching
the students train, a flash of
black catches
my eye.

One minute, fifty-eight point one seconds.
Goal achieved.

At 11:45, a five-minute break—I'm right
on schedule. After that...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's been at it for a while—running laps,
checking her time, then
taking a break.
Must be following a set schedule.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look at her... That's Eishin Flash,
right? Isn't she from
Germany?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's been about a year since she
came here, I think? Not that
I've ever
talked to her...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Shoot, did she hear us? L-let's go
somewhere else.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her stoic bearing and German
heritage—a rarity even among
Tracen's
large foreign exchange crowd—it's no
wonder the other
students are curious
about her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She herself, on the other hand, is either
oblivious to the attention or
simply doesn't
care.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Time to start again.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Hah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her neatly trimmed hair and tail shimmer
in the sunlight, jet-black
strands
undulating as she runs—I find myself drawn
in by the beauty
of it all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, I spot Eishin Flash again elsewhere,
talking with—or more like
trapped with—a
much more energetic student.

Hey, Flash, hey! A small favor to
ask—super small! Come watch me
perform
real quick, 'kay? ♪

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "Real quick." How many minutes is that?
Huh?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon, please be precise with your
language. Approximately
how many
minutes and seconds is this performance
scheduled to last?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
C'mon! What is this, elementary school?
Don't be a meanie!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That was not my intention. I've simply set a
schedule for myself down
to the second
and don't have much time to spare.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ah! There you go again with your schedule! You can be just a little late, right?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No, I cannot permit myself to be off my
schedule by even a second.
That would
not be following things properly.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I have constructed a schedule that
accounts for everything I do down
to the
second, including transit. I made it to be
the perfect schedule
for my improvement.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
So long as I stick to it, I'll be able to
achieve the proper results at
tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I get that this upcoming race is a
super big deal for you, but
still...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: A big deal? No, it's simply what I must do.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Umm... You're not pushing yourself too
hard, right?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, no problems here. Everything is
proceeding without hindrance.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Now, if you'll excuse me, it's already five
minutes and fifty-five
seconds past my
allotted transit time.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Please inform me of your next performance
beforehand. I'll slot it into
my post-tryouts
schedule.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ah—Flash!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An expressionless Eishin Flash runs off
before Falcon can stop her.
She's very
strict about time, that's for sure.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Sigh. Well, there she goes. Now then... You there—I saw you watching! You're coming with me. ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I could feel your passionate gaze from a
mile away. ♪ C'mon, you get
to see my
concert. ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even as I'm being dragged off to places
unknown, thoughts of Eishin
Flash run
through my mind and I decide to check
out her tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what her training will be like
leading up to the day of...
